percentage_strength.heading: strength multiplier
percentage_strength.paragraph:
common sources includes:

  • golden / ender dragon
  • renowned
  • unlimited power

note that the game rounds to first decimal place, and you must check individual sources yourself and sum them up.

for example, with maxed attributes, it will show 1.8% by default, but it is actually 1.75%.
